content: The dosage of this medication must be carefully adjusted by your doctor to effectively treat your infection while minimizing the risk of serious side effects. It is crucial that you do not take more or less of this medication than prescribed. Additionally, you should not stop taking it before completing the full course of treatment unless directed by your doctor, even if you start feeling better. Common side effects may include nausea, vomiting, and loss of appetite. This medication has been prescribed because your doctor has determined that the benefits outweigh the potential risks of side effects. However, some individuals may experience serious side effects, such as blood-related problems, particularly at higher doses. The risk of these complications can be reduced by taking folic or folinic acid as prescribed and undergoing regular blood tests. Severe allergic reactions to this medication are rare. If you experience any unusual symptoms, contact your doctor immediately. This is not a comprehensive list of possible side effects. In the United States, you can call your doctor for medical advice about side effects, or in Canada, consult your doctor for guidance. Before taking this medication, inform your doctor or pharmacist if you are allergic to it or have any other allergies. This product may contain inactive ingredients that could cause allergic reactions or other issues. During pregnancy, this medication should only be used when clearly necessary, and you should discuss the risks and benefits with your doctor. Folic acid is particularly important during pregnancy. This medication can pass into breast milk, so consult your doctor if you are breastfeeding. Drug interactions may alter how this medication works or increase the risk of serious side effects. It is important to keep a list of all the products you use, including prescription and non-prescription drugs, as well as herbal products, and share this information with your doctor and pharmacist. This document does not include all possible drug interactions. In the event of an overdose, if the individual has serious symptoms such as passing out or difficulty breathing, call 911 immediately. Otherwise, contact a poison control center right away. U.S. residents can call 1-800-222-1222, and Canadian residents can call 1-844-764-7669. While taking this medication, regular laboratory and medical tests, such as complete blood counts and liver function tests, should be performed to monitor your condition and detect any potential side effects. If you miss a dose, take it as soon as you remember. If it is near the time of your next dose, skip the missed dose and resume your regular dosing schedule. Do not double the dose to catch up. Store this medication at room temperature, away from light and moisture. Do not store it in the bathroom. Do not flush medications down the toilet or pour them into a drain unless instructed to do so. Properly discard this product when it is expired or no longer needed. This information is a summary and does not contain all possible details about this product. It does not guarantee that the product is safe, effective, or appropriate for you. Always consult your healthcare professional for complete information about this medication and your specific health needs.
